entities.title: Work on Rally
entities.summary: Install, test and build the game in its folder.
steps: npm test (typecheck, then the test suites)
npm run build (into dist/games/retro/rally/; BASE_PATH="" builds at the root)
npm run dev rebuilds on change; serve dist/ with any static server

entities.title: Run the Worker locally
entities.summary: The game, its API and a local copy of the database on localhost.
steps: npx wrangler d1 execute rally-scores --local --file worker/schema.sql
npm run build && npx wrangler dev
entities.verify: The title screen appears and a one-player match can be entered on the table.
entities.details: An online match also needs the games hub on the same origin, from its own repository.

entities.title: Change the database
entities.summary: A schema change is a migration applied by hand before merging.
steps: Add games/rally/worker/migrations/NNNN-what-it-does.sql, numbered from 0002, with a comment saying why
Make the same change in worker/schema.sql
Try it locally: npx wrangler d1 execute rally-scores --local --file worker/migrations/<file>
Apply it to production before merging, and say so in the pull request's description
